name: smwgraphics-rayman
title: Rayman
description:
Rayman...But in SMW Hell Yeah >:). Made by me and just me :D.
The Zip File includes:
GFX32 (Player)
GFX28 (Name)
GFX10 (Overworld Player)
GFX00 (Some Player Tiles)
SMW_Shared.pal (The character color palettes)

Also includes optional GFX:
GFX22
GFX24 (Both removes blushing frames from the vanilla ending)
GFX00alt
GFX32alt (Both alts are made to work with the "Straight Fireballs" patch, replacing Fireballs with Rayman Fists, requested by MegaSonic1999 :^). )

Funny Thing: Like i did with Tangle, Second Player is Rayman, but with Tangle´s colors, to mimic "Green Mario" joke...again xD. (and why not Globox colors?, idk, i didn't like how it look xD, so i chose Tangle just to reference my work)
